correctness.rationale: An exact greedy alternating-subsequence embedding-cost formula was reconstructed. Deleting a letter reduces equal-boundary count by at most one; initial-run analysis rules out e=4 with first symbol one; deleting nonfirst letters of repeated runs supplies all allowed cases. Compositions of run lengths give the closed polynomial. The included executable independently enumerates all 2^n binary strings for n=2,4,...,12 with dynamic-programming LCS and all balanced counts; finite checks are supplementary rather than an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The size of radius-two balls for fixed-multiplicity Ulam metrics is a natural input to sphere packing and exact jumbled-neighborhood enumeration. Existing principal sources explicitly supply arbitrary-center radius-one and sorted-center arbitrary-radius formulas, leaving this non-sorted center and error radius unresolved in those frameworks. The result is a closed uniform all-m formula and structural membership boundary, not an arbitrary small parameter or mere table recomputation; no claim of global optimality of the center is made.
